response.sql:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT sf.zoneref, s.entrystat, sf.traitcount
  FROM scanfeatures AS sf
  INNER JOIN sites AS s
    ON sf.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  WHERE sf.traitcount > 489
), grouped AS (
  SELECT zoneref, entrystat, AVG(traitcount) AS avg_traitcount, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY zoneref, entrystat
)
SELECT zoneref AS site_code,
       entrystat AS access_status,
       avg_traitcount,
       record_count,
       record_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(record_count) OVER (), 0) AS share_of_total
FROM grouped
ORDER BY share_of_total DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: “Passes the 489 threshold” means traitcount is strictly greater than 489; records with NULL traitcount are excluded by the filter.

alternatives.interpretation: If 489 itself qualifies as passing the threshold, use a greater-than-or-equal filter.
